description: Set a password for THIS account (the one your bearer token belongs to). Accounts from register_account have no password by default — the bearer token is the credential. Call this ONCE to enable email+password `login` as a recovery method in case the token is lost. Needs only the new password (min 8 chars, letters+numbers) — no current password the first time. If a password was already set, this returns 409 (use change-password instead).
name: set_password
title: Set account password
